Campers can expect hands-on activities, games, creative challenges, and opportunities to build skills, make new friends, and try something new in a supportive and energetic environment. blurb: Sunnybrook Creek Park Group Campground is surrounded by forests. This is an ideal camping spot for corporate events, family reunions or a weekend away with a large group of friends. The campground is located along highway 39 west of Sunnybrook.
